open_items.title: Border router stack deployment & operation
open_items.doubt: The border router stack is deployed and online. Factory esp_ot_rcp verified on ESP32-H2 over UART2 (/dev/ttyS2, 460,800 baud). otbr container running with network state leader and active dataset generated.
open_items.evidence: Commissioned Sentinel Matter-over-Thread presence sensor into Home Assistant — border router stack 100% verified on live hardware.

open_items.title: Thread operational dataset & HA adoption
open_items.doubt: Thread operational dataset & HA adoption. Home Assistant successfully adopted ApartmentThread as the Preferred Network via OpenThread Border Router integration (REST endpoint http://127.0.0.1:8081). Dataset persisted in HA storage.
open_items.evidence: Adopted in Home Assistant — closed on live hardware.

open_items.title: Concurrent Server & Border Router load stability
open_items.doubt: Radxa Zero 3E running Home Assistant and border-router service simultaneously. Baseline memory proven: Debian 13 Minimal + HA Container uses ~564 MiB total, leaving ~460 MiB on 1 GB (~1.4 GiB on 2 GB). Host/container USB serial contention untested.
open_items.evidence: 24 h load, memory and USB serial log with both services and ESP32-H2 active.

open_items.section_name: SW-1 — Tinxy Switch Plates & Bathroom Input
open_items.title: Tinxy 4+1 local ESP offline control path
open_items.doubt: Tinxy 4+1 local ESP control path — Espressif ESP8266 microcontroller with native ESPHome UART firmware, Tasmota, or Tinxy Local API. Verified 100% offline control with no vendor cloud or developer tokens.
open_items.evidence: Each relay and fan node toggles from HA with the WAN cable out (<50ms latency), state matching the physical contact.

open_items.section_name: SW-1 — Tinxy Switch Plates & Bathroom Input
open_items.title: Neutral wire presence at switchboards
open_items.doubt: Neutral at each room's switchboard — required for in-wall smart switch operation.
open_items.evidence: Electrician's confirmation at each room box (Hall, Study, Bathroom).

open_items.section_name: SW-1 — Tinxy Switch Plates & Bathroom Input
open_items.title: DIY Matter-over-Thread door sensor verification
open_items.doubt: DIY Matter-over-Thread door sensor verification — Option 1 (XIAO ESP32-C6 + MC-38 reed switch). Verify sub-80ms response over Thread to prevent stepping into darkness, and map entity state (off = closed, on = open).
open_items.evidence: Entity flips instantaneously (<80ms) on physical open/close in Home Assistant.

open_items.section_name: SW-1 — Tinxy Switch Plates & Bathroom Input
open_items.title: Mains isolation & bathroom moisture protection
open_items.doubt: Mains isolation and bathroom moisture protection — Confirm door sensor operates 100% isolated from 230V mains (never connect reed switch to Tinxy switchboard). Mount sensor body on exterior door jamb away from shower spray.
open_items.evidence: Sensor installed on exterior frame with safe low-voltage / wireless isolation.

open_items.title: Live entity ID mapping in HA
open_items.doubt: Every entity ID in the register is a placeholder until HA creates the devices.
open_items.evidence: Real entity IDs pasted into the automations, verified to change on physical action.

open_items.title: Pre-checkout supplier pricing & stock check
open_items.doubt: Hardware pricing verified on Indian suppliers; in-cart inventory checks needed prior to checkout.
open_items.evidence: Cart showing current prices and stock at robu.in and robocraze.com.

open_items.title: Enclosure material RF shift verification
open_items.doubt: Enclosure material and mounting shift RF behaviour; distance gates tuned on the bench may not hold on the wall.
open_items.evidence: Re-run the 10-minute field test after the enclosure is fitted.

open_items.title: Hall timer clock persistence on WAN offline restart
open_items.doubt: The hall timer rule depends on the clock. Correct time after a restart with the WAN down is untested.
open_items.evidence: Test H-05 with the WAN disconnected.

open_items.title: Mechanical switch override proof with server offline
open_items.doubt: Manual override is asserted, not demonstrated — including whether automation fights a hand press.
open_items.evidence: Every load operated from its wall switch with Home Assistant stopped.
